summary: Backend API testing complete - 100% pass rate (25/25 tests). All auth, events, and interaction endpoints working correctly with country-aware personalization.
seed_data_creation: Using existing seeded users: admin@accaddeoggi.app and demo@accaddeoggi.app from backend startup
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints fully functional. Country-aware personalization working correctly - Italian users see IT-relevant events, Spanish users see ES-relevant events. Wikipedia API integration working (IT/EN/ES editions). Like/dislike mutual exclusivity and toggle idempotency verified. JWT Bearer token auth pattern correct for mobile app.

auth_endpoints_tested: POST /api/auth/register - with email, password, name, language, country
POST /api/auth/login - returns access_token, refresh_token, user with country
GET /api/auth/me - returns user with country field
POST /api/auth/refresh - exchanges refresh_token for new access_token
events_endpoints_tested: GET /api/events/today - returns events with all required fields
GET /api/events/today?lang=es&country=ES - Spanish user events (different from IT)
GET /api/events/today?scope=local - local events for user's country
GET /api/events/categories - returns category list with colors
interaction_endpoints_tested: GET /api/events/stats - returns likes, dislikes, saves, top_categories
verified_behaviors: Like and dislike are mutually exclusive
Clicking like twice removes the like (toggle idempotency)
Country field present in user registration and responses
Events have scope: global (2+ wiki editions) or local (1 edition)
Italian users do NOT see events only in ES wiki that don't mention Italy
All event fields present: id, year, years_ago, title, text, image_url, category, scope, sources, countries, origin, liked, disliked, saved
JWT Bearer tokens (not cookies) - correct for mobile
